purpose: One locked held-out comparison of project baseline, historical AC-MOT, and new frozen AC-MOT.

systems.name: Baseline_Default
systems.description: Static project baseline: conf=0.25, NMS IoU=0.45, imgsz=640, default ByteTrack profile.

systems.name: Old_ACMOT_Frozen
systems.description: Historical heuristic AC-MOT controller with tuned ByteTrack, W=7, stride=10, original adaptive confidence/NMS/resolution mapping.

systems.name: New_ACMOT_Frozen
systems.description: Validation-selected frozen empirical SCI controller with tuned ByteTrack; no test-time tuning.

merge_rule: Merge all three predeclared systems; do not select or retune based on partial test results.
warning: After any worker accesses test-dev, do not change parameters and later call another run an unbiased held-out final test.
